title: validation.rs precondition comment wrong file
description: The precondition comment at validation.rs:188 says unfolding is done in 'reader/session/command.rs'. That file does not perform header unfolding — it only strips trailing CRLF from command lines. Header unfolding is done in lifecycle.rs (extract_header_value) and did_passthrough.rs. validate_article_ingress is not called anywhere in crates/reader. The comment misleads future callers about which code satisfies the precondition and may cause the precondition to go unsatisfied on a new POST/IHAVE path.
